auth.loginCopy: Log in to your mail workspace.
auth.registerCopy: Get started with your personal mail workspace.
auth.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. Spaces are preserved.
auth.accountExists: An account with this email already exists. Please log in.
auth.registrationRejected: We could not create your account. Check your details and try again. If the problem continues, contact support.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
auth.forbidden: Your account does not have permission to perform this action.
auth.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
auth.expired: Your session expired. Please log in again.
auth.accountError: We could not load your account. You can retry or log out.
auth.gmailUnavailable: Gmail connection is not available yet.
auth.consent: Connect Google to let myMail read your Gmail messages. This does not grant permission to send or delete mail. You can disconnect at any time.
auth.reconnectRequired: Google access has expired or been revoked. Reconnect to continue.
auth.cancelled: Google connection was cancelled. Your existing connection was not changed.
auth.callbackFailed: Google connection could not be completed. Please try connecting again.
auth.connectionError: We could not check your Gmail connection. Please try again.
auth.invalidDetails: Check your account details and try again.
auth.googleRequestRejected: Google could not complete this request. Please try again.
auth.googleConflict: The Google connection could not be updated. Please try again.
auth.googleDisconnectPending: Gmail disconnection is still being completed. Please wait and try again.
